summary_paragraph: A 30-year-old woman was admitted after a suicide attempt involving intentional overdose of tramadol and Phenergan, following an argument with her mother whom she cares for. She has a history of refractory bipolar disorder and depression with prior suicide attempts and ECT, opioid use disorder (now sober since pregnancy), endometriosis with chronic pain, hypothyroidism, and GERD. In the ED, she had transient hypoxia and reduced responsiveness, responded to Narcan, and was medically stabilized. She was monitored for 48 hours without complications, with normal CT head and improving labs. Tramadol was discontinued, Seroquel was reduced to 150mg nightly with PRN dosing for agitation, and she was medically cleared for transfer to inpatient psychiatry for ECT. She was discharged to extended psychiatric care with stable vital signs and clear mental status.
